subject: CAIQ coverage inventory & evidence owner playbook
messages:
From: Evan Morse <evan.morse@citrinefinancial.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SaaS Security Team <security@citrinefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ coverage snapshot and owners for control evidence

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our assessment we need a CAIQ-style coverage snapshot that maps each CAIQ question to the Redwood control owner and an artifact (or placeholder) we can use during our internal validation. Specifically:

- A single spreadsheet mapping CAIQ question IDs -> Redwood control -> evidence filename / link -> point-of-contact (email).
- A short owner playbook (1 pager) explaining how owners should collect logs, SLA windows for evidence delivery, and where to pull long-term retention artifacts.

Can you share a baseline by EOD Monday? Our audit window opens Dec 6 and the security reviewers prefer to have an initial index before the kickoff.

Appreciate it — Evan

--
Evan Morse
Security Engineer, Citrine Financial
security@citrinefinancial.com
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Morse <evan.morse@citrinefinancial.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ coverage snapshot and owners for control evidence

Evan —

Thanks for the clear ask. We'll own putting together a CAIQ coverage inventory and a short owner playbook. Quick plan below:

1) Inventory: Priyom will map the spreadsheet (CAIQ ID / description / Redwood control tag / owner / artifact stub).
2) Evidence index: Monica will assemble existing artifacts into a CSV with filenames and drive links; she will mark items that still need documentation.
3) Playbook: I'll write the 1-page owner playbook (SOP for evidence pulls, retention, and emergency audit responses).

Deliverables and timeline:
- Initial spreadsheet + evidence CSV (draft) by 2026-11-30 5pm PT (attached).
- Owner playbook v0 by 2026-11-30 EOD.

I'm attaching the baseline inventory and a small diagram for context. If you need any particular ordering (e.g., prioritized by audit-critical controls), let me know.

Attachments: [CAIQ coverage inventory v1.xlsx] [design-diagram-kv-cache.png]

Markus Klein
Lead, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ coverage snapshot and owners for control evidence

Markus / Monica —

Uploaded a first-pass mapping in the sheet under the CAIQ tab: each CAIQ question has been cross-referenced to our internal control ID (RC-XXX). Notes on gaps:

- Logging/monitoring questions (CAIQ SecOps section): the evidence path is mature for production clusters, but for Dedicated/private customers we have partial logs (we've flagged those as 'needs sample export').
- Key management (KMS/HSM) items: artifacts exist (KMS rotation policy, HSM attestation) but live links are in PR/infra; Monica — can you extract a PDF snapshot for the evidence bundle?
- Data retention: retention is policy-driven in the Console; I added an example retention manifest but we should include a query used to extract retention logs.

Ben — can you validate the RC- prefix mapping where it touches runtime kernels and quantization (the validators asked for explicit kernel selection evidence)?

I'll mark items in the sheet as: ready / sample_needed / remediation_required.

--
Priyom Das
Security Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Morse <evan.morse@citrinefinancial.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ coverage snapshot and owners for control evidence (deliverables)

Evan —

Attached is the initial CAIQ coverage inventory and a lightweight evidence index. Highlights:

- Inventory: CAIQ questions mapped to Redwood control IDs with named owners and a status column (ready / sample_needed / remediation_required). See tab "owner-index" in the attached workbook.
- Evidence index: CSV with direct drive links where available; we left secure artifacts as "available on request" for HSM/KMS screenshots (we can produce samples under NDA).
- Playbook (summary in the sheet): 1) reach out to owner, 2) request artifact using the CSV link, 3) if sample_needed then request a 48-hr extraction window, 4) for remediation_required submit a ticket to security-triage@redwoodinference.com.

Two calls to action for Citrine team:
1) Please confirm whether you prefer artifacts as Drive links or zipped bundles via secure transfer.
2) If you want prioritization, tell us the top 20 CAIQ IDs you want validated first and we'll sequence the requests to owners.

Attachments: [CAIQ coverage inventory v1.xlsx] [evidence-index-20261129.csv] [design-diagram-kv-cache.png]

Thanks — happy to run a short walkthrough next week.

Markus Klein
Lead, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
